title: Metamodel-Guided LLM Decoding for Consistent DSL Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29749v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate software engineering artifacts written in domain-specific languages (DSLs). Correct DSL instances usually must comply with not only the concrete syntax but also the abstract syntax defined by a metamodel augmented with semantic well-formedness constraints. Existing constrained decoding approaches typically guarantee compliance only with concrete syntax or with a limited set of semantic constraints expressed over the generated text, making metamodel-level constraint consistency difficult to enforce during generation. We present MeMoDecode: a decoding framework that enforces a DSL's concrete syntax, abstract syntax, and well-formedness constraints jointly. Specifically, whenever the LLM generates a complete metamodel concept, MeMoDecode incrementally maps the current output to a partial model and verifies whether it can still be completed into a consistent instance. translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.29749v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地用于生成以领域特定语言（DSL）编写的软件工程制品。正确的DSL实例通常不仅要符合具体语法，还必须符合由元模型定义并辅以语义良构性约束的抽象语法。现有的约束解码方法通常只能保证符合具体语法，或只能保证符合基于生成文本所表达的有限语义约束集合，这使得元模型级别的约束一致性在生成过程中难以强制实施。我们提出了MeMoDecode：一个能够联合强制执行DSL的具体语法、抽象语法和良构性约束的解码框架。具体而言，每当LLM生成一个完整的元模型概念时，MeMoDecode会将当前输出增量地映射为一个部分模型，并验证其是否仍可被补全为一个一致的实例。我们将……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出MeMoDecode解码框架，在LLM生成DSL的过程中联合强制执行具体语法、抽象语法（元模型）和良构性约束，通过增量映射到部分模型并验证其可补全性来确保生成结果的一致性。
en_tdlr: MeMoDecode is a decoding framework that jointly enforces a DSL's concrete syntax, abstract syntax, and well-formedness constraints during LLM generation by incrementally mapping outputs to partial models and verifying that they can still be completed into consistent instances.
